en.headline: A hot day: take care today
body: If your doctor set a limit on drinks, keep to it.
If not, drink water often today.
Stay out of the midday sun.
Get help if you feel dizzy, confused or very weak.
en.passage: If your doctor has limited how much fluid you should drink, follow that advice.

ms.headline: Hari panas: jaga diri hari ini
body: Jika doktor anda hadkan minuman, ikut had itu.
Jika tidak, minum air selalu hari ini.
Dapatkan bantuan jika anda rasa pening, keliru atau sangat lemah.
ms.passage: If your doctor has limited how much fluid you should drink, follow that advice.

zh.headline: 天气很热：今天要小心
body: 如果医生限制了您喝水的量，就照着做。
如果没有，今天要常常喝水。
如果头晕、糊涂或很没力气，就找人帮忙。
zh.passage: If your doctor has limited how much fluid you should drink, follow that advice.
